blocks.text: HANOI, Vietnam — Heavy rain caused flooding across parts of northern Vietnam on Thursday, disrupting travel, inundating homes and pushing several rivers above dangerous levels, authorities and state media said. Rain has fallen across northern and north-central Vietnam this week, with some areas receiving more than 50 centimeters (19.7 inches), according to the disaster prevention department said. More than 2,000 homes have been submerged, many key transportation routes blocked and more than 1,000 households isolated.
